Package com.saicone.gama.util

Interface LabeledDeque<L,E>

Type Parameters:
L - the type of labels in this deque
E - the type of elements in this deque
All Superinterfaces:
Collection<E>, Deque<E>, Iterable<E>, Queue<E>, SequencedCollection<E>
All Known Implementing Classes:
LinkedLabeledList
public interface LabeledDeque<L,E> extends Deque<E>
An extension of the Deque interface that associates a label for each element.
Unlike Deque, this interface will fail with an UnsupportedOperationException when using most of the methods that modify the deque without specifying a label.
